user.title: Connect to the MaBarak add-on
user.description: Enter the host and port of the MaBarak add-on. The defaults work for a standard add-on installation.

data_description.host: Host name of the add-on, as resolved by the Supervisor.
data_description.port: Ingress port of the add-on. Default is 8099.

hassio_confirm.title: MaBarak add-on detected
hassio_confirm.description: Do you want to add {name} to Home Assistant? Its maintenance data will be exposed as sensors and a calendar.

error.cannot_connect: The add-on is unreachable. Check that it is started, then try again.
error.unsupported_version: The add-on version is not compatible with this integration. Update both together.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one MaBarak instance can be configured.
